This can help you connect with the tradition on a deeper level and make more informed decisions. 3. **Seek guidance, not answers**: When seeking guidance from tradition, try to approach it as a conversation rather than a source of definitive answers. This can help you develop a stronger sense of self and increase your confidence in making decisions that align with your own inner voice. By striking a balance between tradition and personal reflection, you can maintain a sense of agency and ownership over your decisions while still honoring the wisdom of the past.
